report.summary: Every tagged sentence was traced and every embedded specific — share counts (89,48,270 / 21,510 / 99.76% / 0.24%), rupee figures (₹5,800-6,200bn, ₹1,000bn, ₹1,443bn, ₹401bn, ₹430-460bn, ₹9tn, ₹1,068.18 lakh, ₹29.11 lakh, ₹2,000/₹897 lakh), percentages (top-10 customer 59/57/59, sub-segment CAGRs 10-15%, SME 70-75%, imports 6.4%/exports 6%), periods (six restated periods, GST 1 July 2017, China 2015, middle class 148m by 2030) and the financial table (PAT, EPS, operating cash flow, total assets across all six periods) — reconciles exactly against the cited pages, including the lakh-to-crore conversions. Names (four promoters, Vivro, Link Intime, 20 Microns Limited) and the NSE EMERGE listing object also check out. No invented figure, wrong year or mismatched citation was found; the only note is an interpretive sentence about the company not selling on its own account, which carries no new specific. The report is soundly sourced and can proceed.
